output.heading: Abstract

spans.text: Data pipelines often stop reproducing their outputs when the libraries they depend on change.
For Python pipelines, recording library versions restored most pipelines whose outputs changed after re-execution.
We test whether the same holds for pipelines written in R.
On eight public R pipelines, a restoration classifier reached 0.75 accuracy (6/8).
The sample is small and exploratory, so the result partly addresses the gap for R only.
